tax.note: Ohio applies sales tax to photography services as tangible personal property.

payment.description: Full payment due at time of booking via Wave invoice. Booking is not confirmed until payment clears.

cancellation.description: Free cancellation more than 48 hours before shoot. Payment held as credit toward future booking.
25% of invoice forfeited for cancellations within 24 hours.
Full invoice retained for no-show or inaccessible property at scheduled time.

weather_reschedule.description: Free reschedule when DigFlat recommends rescheduling due to weather.

licensing.agent_use: Unlimited use for marketing the listed property and agent's personal marketing.
licensing.third_party_use: Photos may not be transferred to other agents, brokerages, or used for other listings without written permission and additional licensing fee.
licensing.expiration: License is tied to the listing. Once property sells or expires, photos may continue to be used in agent's portfolio but not to relist the property under a new agent.
